name: MissinglettrBot
description: The fetcher behind Missinglettr's social-media campaign builder. The operator documents that it crawls a blog post or web page only when a Missinglettr customer submits that content, extracting it so the platform can auto-create social posts, and states explicitly that it does not crawl the web at large like a traditional search engine. Missinglettr documents robots.txt control with a worked MissinglettrBot block and notes that blocking it stops social campaigns being created from the site's content.
